message.content:
A structured wool-blend blazer in a soft camel hue (#E0B69C), featuring a single-breasted cut and notch lapels.
Tailored tapered trousers made of heavy twill in charcoal gray (#36454F) with a mid-thigh length.
A silk-blend blouse in ivory white (#FFFFF0) with a relaxed collar and a dropped shoulder design.
Round-toe leather loafers in cognac brown (#8B4513) with minimal hardware.
Matte gold hoop earrings and a thin silver chain necklace to add subtle polish.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an autumn office day at 18 °C by providing necessary warmth through the blazer without sacrificing breathability. The camel and charcoal palette feels professional yet approachable, adhering strictly to the neat dress code while reflecting her desire for a refined workwear aesthetic. Soft fabrics like silk and wool-blend ensure comfort throughout the daylight hours, making it suitable for both desk work and brief meetings.
